verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Although we've come
To the end of the road
Still I can’t let go
It's unnatural
You belong to me
I belong to you

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Said we'd be forever
Said it'd never die
How could you love me and leave me and never
Say goodbye?

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
When I can't sleep at night
Without holding you tight
Each time I try I just break down and cry
Pain in my head
Oh, I'd rather be dead
Spinning around and around

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Although we've come
To the end of the road
Still I can’t let go
It's unnatural
You belong to me
I belong to you

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
Come
To the end of the road
See you in Colorado
It's just natural
You belong to us
We belong to you
